items.title: After 600 experiments, here's what I discovered about JEPA world models
items.summary: The author shares insights gained from extensive experimentation with JEPA world models, highlighting their potential applications and implications for AI development. This research could inform future model training and enhance understanding of AI behavior.

items.title: Live-migration support in FreeBSD and bhyve coming
items.summary: FreeBSD is set to introduce live-migration support for bhyve, allowing virtual machines to be moved between hosts without downtime. This enhancement is significant for developers and system administrators looking to improve uptime and resource management.

items.title: FM-1 Workbench
items.summary: The FM-1 Workbench project has been launched, providing an open-source platform for developers to experiment with and build upon. This initiative encourages collaboration and innovation within the engineering community.

items.title: Perplexity Decider v1.3: Training, eval, and use cases
items.summary: The latest version of Perplexity Decider introduces new training methodologies and evaluation metrics, enhancing its utility for AI developers. This update is crucial for those looking to refine their models and improve performance.

items.title: Ctrl+C, Ctrl+v, Ctrl+cve: Bypassing Android's Clipboard Read Security Measures
items.summary: A new vulnerability has been identified that allows bypassing Android's clipboard read security measures, posing a risk to user data. Developers and security professionals should be aware of this issue to protect their applications and users.
